title: Booking Deposit Balance Calculation
content:
# Booking Deposit Balance Calculation

Window Replacement Contracts — billing calculation for a contract not yet released to the factory.

- **Measured contract value.** The measured contract value is the signed contract price plus the change-order lines and the fees on the contract, less the price credits.
- **Required deposit.** The standard required deposit is the larger of the series deposit percentage of the measured contract value, rounded to the cent, and the series deposit minimum, but never more than the measured contract value.
- **Deposit balance.** The deposit balance is the required deposit less the payments received toward the contract net of refunds, never below zero, rounded to the cent, and it is paid as a booking deposit.

The deposit percentage and the deposit minimum are the contract series' figures in the deposit, card and final balance schedule.

## Worked example (hypothetical inputs)

| Item | Amount |
|---|---|
| Signed contract price | $9,000.00 |
| Change-order lines | $1,200.00 |
| Fees on the contract | $100.00 |
| Price credits | $300.00 |
| Measured contract value | $10,000.00 |
| Deposit percentage (hypothetical 25%) of the measured value | $2,500.00 |
| Deposit minimum (hypothetical) | $700.00 |
| Required deposit, the larger figure | $2,500.00 |
| Payments received net of refunds | $1,000.00 |
| **Deposit balance** | **$1,500.00** |

## Edge cases (hypothetical)

- Payments received of $2,600 against a required deposit of $2,500: the balance is never below zero, so it is $0.00.
- A measured contract value of $600 with a deposit minimum of $700: the required deposit is capped at the measured contract value, $600.00.
